method: Automated Playwright UI checks with explicitly labeled deterministic AI fixtures. Real PDF rendering and source hashes; NO live provider or measured plan accuracy.
checks: Unconfigured provider is truthful and cannot send drawings
Actual PDF renders five hashed image views; fixture proposals save separately from stock
Evidence modal renders the matching source with a thin correctly bounded overlay
Proposal becomes a pending physical material only after the review form is saved
Linking another proposal preserves quantity and records the reason
Benchmark scores actual saved fixture predictions, penalizing unresolved quantity
Backup download preserves AI provenance and decisions across reload
Wrong source response is rejected without changing saved inventory
Cancellation discards a late fixture response and preserves inventory
Backup restore retains the AI queue with its physical-material links
Mobile AI review fits without horizontal overflow
AI tools replaces canned chat results and does not claim an MCP connection
